author: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>
subject: [PATCH] HID: uclogic: Correct devm device reference for hidinput input_dev name

findings.message: The patch is an incomplete backport and fails to fix the reported use-after-free in hid-uclogic-core.c
findings.evidence: The backport analysis indicates that the downstream patch is missing critical hunks present in the upstream patch: drivers/hid/hid-uclogic-core.c:85 and drivers/hid/hid-uclogic-core.c:144. While the patch correctly applies the fix to drivers/hid/hid-uclogic.c, the vulnerability (UAF caused by incorrect devm parent) remains in the core driver file.

findings.message: Failed allocation of the input name now results in a NULL name instead of preserving the existing name
findings.evidence: In the parent version, the code checked 'if (name)' before assigning to 'hi->input->name'. In the current version, 'hi->input->name' is directly assigned the result of 'devm_kasprintf'. If allocation fails, 'hi->input->name' becomes NULL, whereas the previous behavior was to leave the existing name intact.
